## PRB1.6. Cost-efficiency

-   MUAC actual costs amounted to 242.2M€2022, -1.9% lower than the determined (247.0M€2022) in 2025.

-   MUAC actual costs were allocated across the four Member States in the following way in 2025: Germany (107.3M€2022, 44.3%), Belgium (72.8M€2022, 30.1%), the Netherlands (59.8M€2022, 24.7%), and Luxembourg (2.3M€2022, 0.9%).
